identification: Full-size Kookaburra cricket bat (green Kookaburra face logo, small competition logo top left), printed 'CASCADE TASMANIAN TIGERS 2000/2001' squad panel with 21 names, each with a pen signature beside it on the blade: Jamie Cox (capt), Ricky Ponting (vice capt), Dene Hills, Michael DiVenuto, Shaun Young, Dan Marsh, Sean Clingeleffer, Mark Colegrave, Gerard Denton (very faint), Andrew Downton, Andrew Dykes, Scott Kremerskothen, Scott Mason, Todd Pinnington, Ben Targett, Shannon Tubb, Damien Wright, Mark Atkinson, Brett Geeves, Tony Daly, David Saker. Black grip. This is the standard 'official team bat' format sold as club/fundraising items. Signatures in black/grey pen, a little faded; Ponting's signature is clear and looks consistent with his usual 'R Ponting' scrawl of the era. No COA visible. Armitage estimate $80-140.
